item.title: CVE-2025-12699
item.description: The ZOLL ePCR IOS application has a critical vulnerability that allows attackers to read sensitive local files, potentially exposing patient data and device information. A patch is not mentioned, so immediate action is required. We recommend ensuring that this application is monitored closely and access is limited until more information about the vulnerability is provided.

item.title: CVE-2024-22774
item.description: Panoramic Corporation's Digital Imaging Software version 9.1.2.7600 has a critical vulnerability that allows local attackers to gain higher access privileges. A patch is not mentioned, so immediate action is advised. It is recommended to restrict access to this software until further updates are provided.

item.description: Merge Healthcare's eFilm Workstation versions 4.0 and 4.0.1 have a medium-severity issue that can result in selecting the wrong medical study when multiple studies are open. While there is no patch available for this issue, it is important for staff to be cautious when using the thumbnail panel for study selection. Consider limiting the number of studies open at once to minimize errors.
